title: Pitch shift
description: Moves the pitch up or down and keeps the length. The method matters: wsola is clean for instruments and sounds, voice keeps the character of a singing or speaking voice, granular is the simple first one.

inputs.name: region
inputs.title: Region in
inputs.description: A region (the joins of a loop) to process instead of audio. The result stays a region: it never reaches an audio input, only a region-merge block turns it back into audio.

outputs.name: region
outputs.title: Loop seam
outputs.description: The processed region. Connect it to another effect or to a region-merge block.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.doc: Off passes the sound through untouched (bypass).

parameters.name: semitones
parameters.doc: Semitones to move, with decimals: 12 is an octave up, -12 an octave down, 1.5 a semitone and a half. Or a curve that changes over time: auto(1:0, 4:12) bends up an octave from bar 1 to bar 4 (points in bars, or seconds such as 2.5s); with range the values of the curve are percent of the range.

parameters.name: range
parameters.doc: Only for a curve: when set, the values of auto(...) are percent of this many semitones (auto(1:0, 4:100) with range 12 is an octave up, -100 an octave down), like the pitch knob and range of a sampler. Empty: the values are semitones.

parameters.name: method
parameters.doc: wsola: grains that are lined up with each other, clean for instruments and sounds. voice: one pitch period at a time (PSOLA), keeps the colour of a voice; use it for one singer or speaker. granular: the simple overlap-add of before, a little grainy and metallic. A curve (auto(...)) is moved with a phase vocoder: voice keeps the colour of a voice, the others move the colour along like a tape.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).
